requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement contains concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion) per Pohl §25.2. Decomposed into a functional requirement (inform security service) and a quality requirement (response time constraint). The ambiguity regarding the timing boundary ('within 2 seconds at the latest') is resolved as inclusive (<= 2s) based on Constraint QLT-01 and standard industry definitions.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Removed timing constraint to separate into quality requirement.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service no later than 2 seconds after damage detection.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2. Interpretation of 'within 2 seconds at the latest' as inclusive (<= 2s) based on Constraint QLT-01.
